name: Godson
source: In Godson, you step into the shoes of a unique individual imbued with extraordinary abilities that set you apart from mere mortals. The world around you is far more layered and intricate than most people realize, and as the story unfolds, your choices shape not only your destiny but also the fabric of reality itself.
translation: 在《教子》中，你将扮演一个拥有非凡能力的人，远远有别于寻常凡人。你周围的世界比大多数人所知的更有层次，也更加复杂。随着故事展开，你的选择不仅会塑造自己的命运，还会改变现实本身的构成。
